baseline: Dirty Next RC working source after connection cancellation/deadline corrections; not the published RC-127 or HEAD alone.

scope.ch1: Grid-wide cell revisions; automatic spatial stability depends on visible cells and the retained global hierarchy version.
scope.ch1-marker: CH-1 plus checking the manual marker before the full structural channel guard.
scope.limitations: Root removal and hierarchy edits still invalidate unrelated views. Ordinary automatic property scanning remains. No game API or wire-format changes.

method.processes: 117 sequential fresh Node processes; variant order rotated once per repeat; host not pinned or isolated.
method.backend: Official nengi-buffers writer with counting transport; shared update fragments on; snapshot metrics and binary diagnostics off.
method.step: Instance.step only; excludes application mutation and separate spatial-index work.
method.total: Matching per-tick application mutation + spatial index + Instance.step.
method.gc: Node GC observer over the measured loop, excluding explicit warmup GC; event duration, not allocated bytes or full game pauses.
method.memory: Heap increase from before construction to after warmup, following explicit GC at each boundary; retained state only.
method.summary: Median of the three per-run means and p95s, not a pooled distribution.
method.excluded: Sockets, client decode/rendering, and real game load generators.
method.distributionNote: The harness uses homogeneous 3D positions for channel-3d/manual-channel-3d unless cell-crossing is selected, even if the setting says single-cell. The 128-unit broad world initially fits within the 512-unit cell.

guardDecision: Not retained: modest sparse automatic gains but mixed controls versus CH-1 alone; no clear general benefit.
